title: Hidden Sugar Detected
short_message: This product contains ingredients that act like sugar or rapid carbohydrates, even if labeled differently.
what_detected: BOTIA found: maltodextrin, glucose syrup, corn syrup, fruit juice concentrate, hydrolyzed starch, or dextrin. These are technically not 'sugar' but break down as sugars or fast carbs in your body.
why_it_matters: Products labeled 'natural,' 'fit,' or 'healthy' often use these ingredients to add sweetness and texture while avoiding the word 'sugar.' If you're watching sugar intake, these still count. If you give this product to children, these hidden forms are worth knowing about.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot tell you how much sugar/carbs are inside, whether the product is suitable for your diet, or if it will spike your blood sugar. It only signals the presence of sugar-like ingredients.
source_note: Detection based on ingredient list analysis. If concerned about sugar intake, check the nutrition table for 'carbohydrates' and 'sugars.'
